name: Tsutawatteru no ni, Tsutawaranai
original_name: 伝わってるのに、伝わらない
source:
It's a perfectly normal high school love story starring a somewhat abnormal girl!
The cool, intellectual Suzumiya Rion.
She usually keeps her distance from her classmates, but for some reason, she invited me out on a date!
And the secret Rion's hiding will finally be revealed…

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2175490/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一段再普通不过的高中恋爱故事，主角却是个有些不寻常的女孩！
冷静又聪慧的Suzumiya Rion。
她平时总与同学保持距离，不知为何却约我出去约会！
Rion隐藏的秘密终于要揭晓…

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2175490/]Steam[/url]]
